items.question: Should the kaula essence originating from yoginīs be given to one endowed with all states and resolved mind?
premises: Kaula essence is not to be given.
Recipient must have all states and resolved mind.
items.inference: The kaula essence is withheld unless recipient is fully endowed and resolved.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic relation of dātavyaṃ and deyaṃ unclear.
items.plain_english: To one endowed with all states and resolved mind, it should be given.
